description: Free. Builds the EIP-712 Mandate the manager's OWNER signs to let the cloud executor run it: manager, strategy and its sha256, operations and USDC a day, expiry. Checks the manager (type from its implementation) and that the strategy fits it. Also says whether the executor is already the manager's operator — if not, the owner first sends setOperator(operator, true) (prepare_set_operator). Sign `typedData` with eth_signTypedData_v4 within 10 minutes, then executor_subscribe.

maxOpsPerDay.description: Operations a day the executor may send (default 6, or the strategy's own lower budget)

maxUsdcPerDay.description: USDC a day it may charge the manager's credit (default 2)

strategy.description: envelop/follow-price (Volatile), envelop/compound (Stable), or a Think Tank id think-tank/<slug> (list_strategies)

name: executor_prepare
title: Cloud executor: the Mandate to sign
